dogecoin.text: Bitcoin's price fell over 2% to $96,300, Ethereum decreased by 3% to $2,669, and XRP plunged nearly 6% to $2.56. Dogecoin also lost 4% of its value, trading at $0.244.
The SEC's guidance did not significantly impact the prices of mined assets like Bitcoin and Dogecoin, which are down 0.1% and 1.1%, respectively.
